target.title: fix(agents): extend thinking error recovery to body, detail, and responseBody carriers
target.body:
## Summary

Closes #98368.

Extends the Anthropic thinking-block error recovery detector to inspect three additional carrier fields (`body`, `detail`, `responseBody`) that commonly hold provider error detail in production wrappers (fetch-style responses, structured-error wrappers).

## Changes

- **Source** (3 lines): Added `current.body`, `current.detail`, `current.responseBody` to the `shouldRecoverAnthropicThinkingError` candidate list in `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/thinking.ts`
- **Tests** (42 lines): Added 3 parameterized positive cases for the new carriers to the existing `wrapAnthropicStreamWithRecovery` table test, plus a negative regression test verifying that non-thinking errors carried in these fields do not trigger recovery.

## Scope

- 2 files, +45 lines
- String-only carriers — no heuristic or serialization guard needed (unlike the deferred `data` path)
- Follows the same pattern as the existing `errorBody` carrier from #98334

## Test results

```
Test Files  2 passed (2)
     Tests  104 passed (104)
```
